description: This Java class 'WordsSQLiteConnectionPrefsProvider' implements the 'PrefsProvider' interface to manage preferences related to SQLite connections for word dictionaries in the AnySoftKeyboard project. It handles loading and storing word data with associated locale information, utilizing RxJava's Observable for asynchronous operations.

classes.name: WordsSQLiteConnectionPrefsProvider
classes.description: A provider class that manages preferences for SQLite-based word dictionaries, supporting loading and storing word data with locale-specific configurations.

methods.name: WordsSQLiteConnectionPrefsProvider
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the provider with context, database filename, and derives locale list from external dictionary add-ons.

methods.name: providerId
methods.description: Returns a unique identifier string for this preferences provider.

methods.name: getPrefsRoot
methods.description: Builds and returns a PrefsRoot object containing locale-specific word data loaded from the SQLite database.

methods.name: storePrefsRoot
methods.description: Stores the preferences from a given PrefsRoot into the SQLite database, updating word entries.
